*Heat crawls along the strike, or frost flowers across the skin where it passes.*

**Target:** One visible creature within 6 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** fire.

**Weak defense:** Burning 2. **Standard defense:** Burning 1.

**Spell:** Provokes when cast beside an enemy.

### Spell Screen

details.flavorMarkdown: *A self-taught caster with scorched cuffs, an improvised focus and an uneven collection of protective charms. Talent is real; discipline and confidence are less reliable.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Scorched practice marks cover a sheltered wall.

**Purpose:** Protect a secret, settle a debt, or prove an underestimated talent.

**Tactics and retreat:** Burn a clustered approach and use Spell Screen against a rival caster.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Close the distance or offer a way out that preserves their pride.

**Habitat:** Tower; settlement · **Communication:** Common and one scholarly language

**Loot:** Focus, notes and 20 coins; no automatic learnable spell or recipe.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-hedge-sorcerer


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Elemental caster · **CV:** 16

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cinder dart | Knowledge | 1 Boon | 3 fire damage. | 4 fire damage. Burning 1. | 6 fire damage. Burning 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** fire

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.35

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=5.000, O=4.653. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [elemental burn](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/monster-abilities/elemental-burn.md), [spell screen](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/64089a1c8961d7faff172f179448a8b6e57827ef/design/monster-abilities/spell-screen.md).
